Italian

flotta

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈflɔt.ta/
  • Rhymes: -ɔtta

Etymology 1

[edit]

Borrowed from French flotte.

Noun

[edit]

flotta f (plural flotte)

  1. (nautical, aviation, military) fleet
Related terms
[edit]
  • flottare
  • flottiglia

Etymology 2

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

flotta

  1. inflection of flottare:
    1. third-person singular present indicative
    2. second-person singular imperative

Swedish

[edit]
English Wikipedia has an article on:
log driving
Wikipedia
Swedish Wikipedia has an article on:
flottning
Wikipedia sv

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • Audio:(file)

Noun

[edit]

flotta c

  1. (military) a navy
  2. (nautical) a fleet (more generally)
  3. (by extension) a fleet (of buses, taxis, or the like)

Declension

[edit]
Declension of flotta
nominative genitive
singular indefinite flotta flottas
definite flottan flottans
plural indefinite flottor flottors
definite flottorna flottornas

See also

[edit]
  • flottilj

Verb

[edit]

flotta (present flottar, preterite flottade, supine flottat, imperative flotta)

  1. to transport (logs or the like) on flowing water (like a river), to do log driving, to float logs
